comparison.objective: Move a heavy carton onto a low platform while keeping it upright; candidate performs screen separation.
comparison.physical_skill: Edge placement, levering, and pushing a heavy load versus coordinated screen handling and granular flow.
comparison.success_condition: Carton flat on platform without excessive tilt versus media recovered, washers retained, and no spill/damage.
comparison.reason: Heavy-load transfer is physically different from aperture-based sorting.
